signature: SUBROUTINE ZHBGST( VECT, UPLO, N, KA, KB, AB, LDAB, BB, LDBB, X,

params.name: vect
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: do not form the transformation matrix X;
-   `= 'V'`: form X.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrices A and B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ka
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of subdiagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KA} \ge 0$.

params.name: kb
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals of the matrix B if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of subdiagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KA} \ge \mathrm{KB} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference:
On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the Hermitian band matrix A, stored in the first ka+1 rows of the array. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(ka+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{ka}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{ka})$.

On exit, the transformed matrix $X^H \, A \, X$, stored in the same format as A.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KA}+1$.

params.name: BB
params.reference: The banded factor S from the split Cholesky factorization of B, as returned by ZPBSTF, stored in the first kb+1 rows of the array.

params.name: ldbb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `BB`. $\mathrm{LDBB} \ge \mathrm{KB}+1$.

params.name: X
params.reference: If `VECT = 'V'`, the n-by-n matrix X. If `VECT = 'N'`, the array X is not referenced.

params.name: ldx
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array X. $\mathrm{LDX} \ge \max (1,N)$ if `VECT = 'V'`; $\mathrm{LDX} \ge 1$ otherwise.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
